# Claude models compared: cost vs quality at every effort level

> What each Claude model (Fable, Opus, Sonnet, Haiku) costs at every effort level, and which gives the best quality for the price. Open data, CC BY 4.0.

Best value overall: Sonnet 5.5 at high effort, 4.3× cheaper than the price trend for its quality (expected score 65.3 % on the benchmark panel, cost 1.8× the cheapest couple). Best pick by task tier: grunt work → Sonnet 5.5 at high effort; everyday tasks → Sonnet 5.5 at high effort; advanced reasoning → Opus 5.5 at medium effort; cutting-edge thinking → Opus 5.5 at high effort. Highest measured quality: Opus 5.5 at max effort (expected score 74.6 %, cost 18× the cheapest couple).

Costs are multiples of the cheapest couple's; quality is the expected score on the benchmark panel. Both are fused from measurements taken on the same task by a latent-quality model that estimates each benchmark's own scale (method: docs/METHODOLOGY.md in the source repository), from 172 sources · 491 benchmarks · 3435 measurements. Updated 2026-09-30. Figures are indicative, derived from public third-party measurements; not affiliated with Anthropic.

## Report

- [Claude models compared: cost vs quality at every effort level](https://claude-models.agensse.com/): quality vs cost per model and effort level, Pareto frontier, best pick per task tier, normalized cost matrix, method and sources.
- [Fable vs Opus vs Sonnet vs Haiku: Claude models head-to-head](https://claude-models.agensse.com/claude-models-head-to-head.html): every pair of Claude models compared effort by effort, and the cheapest effort of each that matches the other.

## Head-to-head

- Fable 5.1 vs Opus 5.5: At the same effort (low, medium, high, xHigh, max), Fable 5.1 costs 1.5× to 3.3× what Opus 5.5 costs and scores between 3.8 points lower and 1.0 point higher on the benchmark panel. To match Fable 5.1 at max (71.8 %, cost 27×), the cheapest Opus 5.5 setting is medium (71.1 %, cost 3.4×): 8.0× less per task. No Fable 5.1 setting reaches Opus 5.5 at max (74.6 %): Fable 5.1's best is max at 71.8 %.
- Fable 5.1 vs Sonnet 5.5: At the same effort (low, medium, high, xHigh, max), Fable 5.1 costs 2.0× to 7.7× what Sonnet 5.5 costs and scores between 0.7 points higher and 12.3 points higher on the benchmark panel. To match Fable 5.1 at max (71.8 %, cost 27×), the cheapest Sonnet 5.5 setting is xHigh (69.7 %, cost 4.1×): 6.6× less per task. To match Sonnet 5.5 at max (70.5 %, cost 14×), the cheapest Fable 5.1 setting is high (68.7 %, cost 10×): 1.4× less per task.
- Fable 5.1 vs Haiku 4.5: Haiku 4.5 is measured at a single setting, with no effort levels, so the two are compared through their cheapest matches. No Haiku 4.5 setting reaches Fable 5.1 at max (71.8 %): Haiku 4.5's best is its only setting at 38.3 %. To match Haiku 4.5 (38.3 %, cost 1.2×), the cheapest Fable 5.1 setting is low (65.3 %, cost 7.0×): 5.7× more per task.
- Opus 5.5 vs Sonnet 5.5: At the same effort (low, medium, high, xHigh, max), Opus 5.5 costs 1.3× to 3.1× what Sonnet 5.5 costs and scores between 4.0 points higher and 13.8 points higher on the benchmark panel. No Sonnet 5.5 setting reaches Opus 5.5 at max (74.6 %): Sonnet 5.5's best is max at 70.5 %. To match Sonnet 5.5 at max (70.5 %, cost 14×), the cheapest Opus 5.5 setting is medium (71.1 %, cost 3.4×): 4.1× less per task.
- Opus 5.5 vs Haiku 4.5: Haiku 4.5 is measured at a single setting, with no effort levels, so the two are compared through their cheapest matches. No Haiku 4.5 setting reaches Opus 5.5 at max (74.6 %): Haiku 4.5's best is its only setting at 38.3 %. To match Haiku 4.5 (38.3 %, cost 1.2×), the cheapest Opus 5.5 setting is low (64.3 %, cost 2.1×): 1.7× more per task.
- Sonnet 5.5 vs Haiku 4.5: Haiku 4.5 is measured at a single setting, with no effort levels, so the two are compared through their cheapest matches. No Haiku 4.5 setting reaches Sonnet 5.5 at max (70.5 %): Haiku 4.5's best is its only setting at 38.3 %. To match Haiku 4.5 (38.3 %, cost 1.2×), the cheapest Sonnet 5.5 setting is low (53.0 %, cost 1.0×): 1.2× less per task.
- Fable 5.1 vs Fable 5: At the same effort (low, medium, high, xHigh, max), Fable 5.1 costs 0.9× to 1.1× what Fable 5 costs and scores between 2.2 points higher and 4.6 points higher on the benchmark panel. No Fable 5 setting reaches Fable 5.1 at max (71.8 %): Fable 5's best is max at 69.0 %. To match Fable 5 at max (69.0 %, cost 24×), the cheapest Fable 5.1 setting is medium (67.7 %, cost 8.4×): 2.8× less per task.
- Opus 5.5 vs Opus 5: At the same effort (low, medium, high, xHigh, max), Opus 5.5 costs 0.5× to 1.3× what Opus 5 costs and scores between 1.0 point higher and 4.8 points higher on the benchmark panel. No Opus 5 setting reaches Opus 5.5 at max (74.6 %): Opus 5's best is max at 69.9 %. To match Opus 5 at max (69.9 %, cost 14×), the cheapest Opus 5.5 setting is medium (71.1 %, cost 3.4×): 4.0× less per task.
- Sonnet 5.5 vs Sonnet 5: At the same effort (low, medium, high, xHigh, max), Sonnet 5.5 costs 0.5× to 1.4× what Sonnet 5 costs and scores between 5.9 points higher and 11.4 points higher on the benchmark panel. No Sonnet 5 setting reaches Sonnet 5.5 at max (70.5 %): Sonnet 5's best is max at 60.2 %. To match Sonnet 5 at max (60.2 %, cost 9.8×), the cheapest Sonnet 5.5 setting is high (65.3 %, cost 1.8×): 5.6× less per task.
